projectDescription: Shejiu is a backend management system for the Baiying influencer e-commerce ecosystem, covering product management, selection library, operations center, financial details, and red packet distribution.
keyFeatures: Open-sea product management with brand grouping and priority pinning
Selection library with countdown logic and brand display rules
Operations center with influencer multi-select filtering
Financial details across company, influencer, and selector views
Red packet creation, listing, and automated task management
Captcha automation via CDP + Qwen3.7 Plus AI recognition
ECharts-based data visualization with layout stability fixes
ADB MySQL columnar storage with specific constraint awareness
publicApiSurface: Captcha solver: CDP port mapping (Baiying: 9340+index, Taobao: 9335 fixed)
Qwen3.7 Plus image recognition API (returns instruction, grid, targets)
influencerDouyinIds query parameter (comma-separated) for operations center filtering
handlePriorityPinned field for pinned product display
7-day average financial metrics (金额/单量/战绩)
